references.text: Lamentations describes the fulfillment of the curse where Jerusalem's children were taken into captivity to Babylon
Jeremiah prophesies that sons and daughters will be devoured, which relates to the curse of losing one's children
Jeremiah is told not to have children because they will die from disease and be taken away, a direct parallel to the curse in Deuteronomy
Historical fulfillment where Nebuchadnezzar took Jerusalem's inhabitants, including sons and daughters, into captivity to Babylon
Joel describes how Judah's sons and daughters were sold to the nations, a fulfillment of the curse concerning the loss of children
A parallel curse in the same chapter where sons and daughters are given to another people
Jesus prophesies that Jerusalem's inhabitants will be taken away as captives to all nations, an eschatological fulfillment of this curse
